description: [Compliance & counterparty] Screen a customer, supplier or payee against official sanctions lists before onboarding, contracting or paying them. Use when one party must be cleared before money or goods move. Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/sanctions-screen

country.description: Optional ISO 3166 alpha-2 code or country name (nationality/address); boosts matching entries

dob.description: Optional date of birth YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (persons); mismatching DOBs lower the score

name.description: Person or company name to screen (any script; transliterated)

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: screen_sanctions
title: Sanctions Screen (OFAC, EU, UK, UN) ($0.02)
